sender.bs: Reklama sa poznatom ličnošću, pa „finansijski savjetnik“ ili „broker“
sender.en: An ad featuring a celebrity, then a “financial adviser” or “broker”

name.bs: Lažne kripto investicije koje „promovišu“ poznate ličnosti

how.bs: Na Facebooku, Instagramu ili TikToku pojavi se reklama ili lažni članak koji izgleda kao vijest domaćeg portala: poznati biznismen ili političar „otkriva“ kako zarađuje na kripto platformi. Nakon prijave javlja se „savjetnik“ preko WhatsAppa, Vibera ili Telegrama. Mali ulog brzo „raste“ na ekranu, pa slijede veće uplate, a kad hoćete isplatu traže „porez“ ili naknadu za deblokadu. Nekad traže i da instalirate AnyDesk.
how.en: On Facebook, Instagram or TikTok an ad or a fake article appears that looks like news from a local portal: a well-known businessman or politician “reveals” how they earn on a crypto platform. After you sign up, an “adviser” gets in touch on WhatsApp, Viber or Telegram. A small deposit quickly “grows” on screen, larger payments follow, and when you want to withdraw they ask for a “tax” or an unblocking fee. Sometimes they ask you to install AnyDesk.

text.bs: Reklama ili „članak“ s poznatom ličnošću i velikom zaradom.
text.en: An ad or “article” with a celebrity and big earnings.

text.bs: „Savjetnik“ se javlja na WhatsApp, Viber ili Telegram.
text.en: An “adviser” gets in touch on WhatsApp, Viber or Telegram.

text.bs: Traži da instalirate AnyDesk ili TeamViewer.
text.en: Asks you to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer.
To withdraw you must pay a “tax” or “unblocking” fee.

text.bs: Dobar dan, ja sam vaš lični menadžer sa platforme. Vaš početni ulog od 500 KM već je donio 1.380 KM. Da biste povukli profit, potrebno je uplatiti porez od 15% na račun naše partnerske kompanije. Instalirajte AnyDesk da vam pomognem oko isplate.
text.en: Good afternoon, I’m your personal manager from the platform. Your initial deposit of 500 KM has already made 1,380 KM. To withdraw the profit you need to pay a 15% tax to our partner company’s account. Install AnyDesk so I can help you with the payout.

bs: reklama poznati biznismen zarađuje na kriptovalutama
uložio u kripto platformu sa facebooka
ne mogu povući novac sa platforme
aplikacija za trgovanje donosi hiljade maraka mjesečno
centralna banka navodno htjela zabraniti snimak
en: ad with a famous businessman earning on crypto
invested in a crypto platform from facebook
asked for a tax to withdraw my profit
investment adviser asked me to install anydesk
can’t withdraw money from the platform
trading app brings in thousands a month
central bank supposedly wanted the video banned

bs: Garantovana zarada bez rizika i pritisak da uložite odmah.
Poznate ličnosti ne reklamiraju takve platforme; članci su izmišljeni.
Uplata na privatne račune u inostranstvu.
Za isplatu „vlastitog“ novca traže još uplata.
en: Guaranteed returns with no risk and pressure to invest now.
Celebrities don’t advertise such platforms; the articles are invented.
To withdraw “your own” money they ask for more payments.

bs: Ne instalirajte AnyDesk ni TeamViewer na nečiji zahtjev.
Ne plaćajte „porez“ ni naknade za isplatu; prekinite kontakt.
Javite banci i prijavite slučaj najbližoj policijskoj upravi.
en: Don’t install AnyDesk or TeamViewer at someone’s request.
Don’t pay a “tax” or payout fees; cut off contact.
Tell your bank and report it to the nearest police administration.
